sections.shortTitle: Criminal Law Extinction of Discriminatory Privileges Act 1949
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

THE CRIMINAL LAW (EXTINCTION OF DISCRIMINATORY PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1949
THE CRIMINAL LAW (EXTINCTION OF DISCRI MINATORY PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1949
ACT No. II of 1950
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gaz. of P., Ext., 1949, p. 772.
The Act has been (i) applied to Baluchistan with effect on
and from the 13th January 1950: see Gaz. of P., dated the 25th July, 1952, Pt.
I, p. 110; (ii) applied in the Federated Areas of Baluchistan, see ibid., 1953,
Pt. I, p 152; and (iii) extended to the Leased Areas of Baluchistan, by the
Leased Areas (Laws) Order, 1950 (G. G. O. 3 of 1950).)
[13th January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the extinction of certain discriminatory
privileges in the criminal law
WHEREAS it is expedient to
provide for the extinction of certain discriminatory privileges in the criminal
law;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title extent and commencement.-(1) This Act may be cited
as the Criminal Law (Exinction of Discriminatory Privileges) Act, 1949.
(Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform)
Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for the original sub-section
(2) (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).)[(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
